India and Japan Deepen Strategic and Economic Ties

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in India to deepen strategic and economic partnerships. The leaders unveiled 16 summit outcomes aimed at strengthening cooperation, including an AI roadmap for areas like LLMs, data centers, and semiconductors, reflecting a push for tech sovereignty. Both sides agreed to deepen economic ties, with potential for multi-billion dollar deals. The visit also included discussions on the Indo-Pacific region, with Japan emphasizing the need for an open and free region. Separately, Prime Minister Modi is scheduled to visit Indonesia, Australia, and New Zealand.
